resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Dictionaries[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

A useful dictionary function is [b]get()[/b]. It does the same thing as indexing, but if the key is not found in the dictionary it returns another specified value instead.

[s0l0!-header][b]Example:[/b][/s0l0!-header][code format="py" codeId="3103"]pairs = {
   1: "apple",
   "orange": [2, 3, 4], 
   True: False, 
   12: "True",
}

print(pairs.[b]get[/b]("orange"))
print(pairs.[b]get[/b](7, 42))
print(pairs.[b]get[/b](12345, "not found"))[/code]
[note]To determine how many items a dictionary has, use the [b]len()[/b] function.[/note]

resolved.title: 查找联系人详情
resolved.problem_statement_md:
你正在制作一个电话簿。联系人存储在一个**字典** 中，其中键是名字，值是一个列表，代表联系人的号码和电子邮件。

你需要实现搜索功能：将联系人的名字作为输入，输出电子邮件。
如果没有找到该联系人，则输出 "**未找到**"。
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Dictionary Functions[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

You are making a phonebook. The contacts are stored in a [b]dictionary[/b], where the key is the name and the value is a list, representing the number and the email of the contact.
You need to implement search: take the name of the contact as input and output the email.
If the contact is not found, output "[b]Not found[/b]". 
[note]Note, that the email is the second element of the list.[/note]
resolved.hint_md: 电子邮件是列表的第二个元素。
